D/ LAVREL COM[M]ODVS AVG ; R/ TR P III IM II COS PP ; R/ RIC III no.655

An incomplete silver denarius of the Roman period, from the reign of Commodus as Augustus (AD 175-192) dated AD 177-78. Reece period 8. Obverse description: laureate,draped bust right. Obverse inscription: LAVREL COM[M]ODVS AVG. Reverse description:Salus seated left, holding branch over serpent arising from an altar. Reverse inscription:TR P III IM II COS PP. The coin is in fine condition with just a little wear on both faces, especially above the bust on the obverse. The patina is a dark grey colour. Slight oddity is the 'P' missing from the 'IMP' on the reverse inscription. RIC III no.655. Sear Roman coins vol.2 p386
